title: Crosswalks of SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001 and the HIPAA Security Rule to NIST SP 800-53, and of ISO/IEC 27001 to SOC 2, as proposals for a person to decide

source.publisher: Intellectual Frontiers LLC, from the catalogs of this repository
source.edition: Mapping of SP 800-53 Revision 5 to ISO/IEC 27001 (Online Informative References program) (unread); Mapping of the Trust Services Criteria to NIST SP 800-53 (unread); Mapping of the HIPAA Security Rule to NIST SP 800-53 (NIST SP 800-66 Revision 2) (unread)

licence: Own words of Intellectual Frontiers LLC under the PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0. Every mapping is a proposal of ours that names two controls that exist in the catalogs of this repository and says why they are said to meet; it is not a mapping published by NIST, the AICPA, ISO or the Department of Health and Human Services, none of which was read. A row that still carries the words person-decision-required MUST NOT be counted.
notice: No published mapping was read: the mappings of NIST SP 800-53 to ISO/IEC 27001, of the Trust Services Criteria to SP 800-53 and of the Security Rule to SP 800-53 were not fetched. Every row is our proposal, intersects-with at strength 1, and carries the words person-decision-required and its reason; a consumer MUST NOT count a row that still carries them. The crosswalk of ISO/IEC 27001 to SOC 2 is derived through the controls of SP 800-53 that both sides share. The clauses 4 to 10 of ISO/IEC 27001 are not mapped.
